learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to search literature databases to acquire the knowledge necessary for describing, analyzing, and interpreting engineering problems in the field of mechanical engineering and machine design.
The student is able to plan the manufacturing process for the developed solution and define the basic requirements for its quality control and implementation costs.
The student prepares a diploma project and carries out design work related to the technological process using available literature and tools.
The student performs the necessary calculations, tests, analyses, and comparisons using appropriate methods and tools to solve a practical engineering problem.

The student is able to develop and document a solution to a simple design or technological problem in the field of mechanical engineering and machine design, and present the results using appropriate computer tools.

assessment_methods.method: Assessment of the Engineering Diploma Project

assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the assessment of the Engineering Diploma Project is 56.0%.
bibliography: Literature relevant to the topic of the thesis.
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
